resources.string: Lumen OS is up to date
Updates are never installed without your OK.
You can keep watching. The projector restarts only when you say so.
Lumen OS %1$s is installed. Restarting takes about 2 minutes.
The update finishes the next time the projector restarts or is switched off completely.
Lumen OS %1$s was restored. Nothing was lost.
A check after the update found a problem: %1$s. If something does not work, use the installer’s rescue. Your data stays.
Scan the code to open the rescue guide.
a system service did not start
the lamp and fan service did not start
the system could not confirm that the new version works
going back to the previous version was not possible
Before the first update, the other system slot (%1$s) must be prepared once with a computer, as the installation guide describes (step vbmeta). Scan the code to open the guide.
The state of the other system slot could not be read. Restart the projector and try again.
This takes a few minutes in the background. You can keep watching.
This version is still being checked after the last update. Try again in a few minutes.
This update is not made for this projector’s firmware (%1$s).
This update is for another Lumen OS edition (%1$s).
This update needs Lumen OS %1$s or newer. Please use the computer installer.
The projector is too warm right now. Try again later.
The update service is not available. Restart the projector and try again.
Protected-video components are missing on this projector. The update works, but protected video needs the blobs step of the computer installer.

To install into the other system slot (%1$s), the update copies the projector’s XGIMI firmware (boot, bootloader, display and audio firmware, configuration) unchanged from the running slot (%2$s). Nothing is modified, decrypted or sent anywhere, and vbmeta is never written. XGIMI’s own updates do the same. Calibration and settings partitions are never touched.
No connection to the update server.
The update information is not signed by Lumen OS and was ignored.
The download was damaged and will be downloaded again.
The update could not be installed (code %1$d). The current version keeps working.
Not enough space on the projector for the update.
No Lumen OS update was found on a USB stick.
